text_block_list.text:
While searching for Curren Chan, who 
didn't come to training—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~, sorry about that. Curren was just 
in the mood for sweets today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just feeling a little tired. Big 
brother, you have times like that too, 
right? Don't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm just feeling a little tired. Big 
sister, you have times like that too, 
right? Don't you?

text_block_list.name: Cafe Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Here are your two Fluffy Strawberry 
Parfaits~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~♪ Here you go, Big 
Brother. Take one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much~♪ Here you go, Big 
Sister. Take one, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren might not be able to eat two whole 
parfaits. But it'd be sad for both the 
cafe and the parfait to leave leftovers... 
so, will you eat with me?

...The parfait that had already been 
ordered wasn't to blame. Reluctantly, I 
ate the parfait while giving her a lecture 
about what happened.
